standard_prerequisites.name: Structure of a coproduct decomposition of a representable sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma lemma-coproduct-sheaves-open-and-closed, used at proof lines 1238-1240
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes each F_i -> U representable by open and closed immersions.

core_obligations: Apply the coproduct lemma to represent each F_i by an open and closed subscheme U_i of U (proof lines 1238-1241).
Conclude U = coproduct U_i by testing the equality of sheaves on points (proof lines 1241-1243).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if a representable sheaf U on (Sch/S)_{fppf} is isomorphic to a coproduct of sheaves F_i, then each F_i is representable by an open and closed subscheme U_i of U and U is the coproduct of the U_i (source lines 1228-1236). The proof deduces from the coproduct lemma that each F_i -> U is representable by open and closed immersions, and then recovers the scheme-theoretic coproduct decomposition by testing the sheaf equality on points.
